scope: AR matrix/address descriptors including mandatory conditional compressor work; vector/SFU/service microcode remains separate and must be added. MTP and vision excluded.

legacy.note: Measured group=8 element pairs, no implemented shadow bank. Headline hides writes by assumption. Static program does not eliminate fetch/dispatch or guard. Config registers written live.

matrix_inventory.conditional_note: At compression boundary all four wk execute; other parity only L20 wk. Compressor wkv/wgate projections themselves execute each token. Counts are full-boundary upper work, not all arithmetic instructions.

selected_scheduler_compatibility.note: Global sums are not critical-path latency. Sum dispatch service on actual shared ports; independent clusters may fetch concurrently. 16KiB store holds256 entries, not full591 global program. Per-cluster capacity depends layers/matrices assigned. Loop expansion removes refetch only if generator/state is implemented and priced.

proposed_minimum.mechanism: Immutable static 64B matrix templates plus runtime epoch/operation/expert/slot identities, bounded FIFO, row/K/group/expert affine counters and bank-map lookup. Read immutable template locally; no host config per weight word.
proposed_minimum.template_full_model_simple_fit: 64KiB globally holds591 templates with room for explicitly counted additions; does not prove full vector/service program fits. Per-cluster replicated stores charge physical macro geometry.
proposed_minimum.affine_expert_mapping: If each of384 experts has same bank geometry per layer, use matrix template + expert_id*expert_stride; otherwise charge explicit per-expert base table. Do not assume arbitrary packed layout is affine.
proposed_minimum.mutable_state_protection: SRAM/control protection, transaction ID, descriptor validity, bank/address bounds, no generation wrap while live remain mandatory. Immutable descriptor ROM requires no ECC per owner policy.
proposed_minimum.address_costs: Counter additions per accepted beat; compare/final flags; bank-boundary carry; source mapping lookup; output row ID generation; golden-tail masks; separately valid w1,w3,w2 strides. Model mux width and map port count when multiple weight lanes issue.
proposed_minimum.no_hidden_overlap: Default charge four descriptor read cycles plus nine total cold control cycles. Only subtract proven prefetch when future operands/IDs ready, shadow context distinct, shared port available, old phase drained.

required_before_complete_model: Compile concrete bank allocation and emit executable descriptors for every AR matrix family, including Engram, compressor parity, embedding, head and dedicated FP32 hc.
Add vector/SFU/index/attention/link service command ROM inventory; this artifact is not a complete all-instruction program.
Sum per-cluster template count/replica bytes after placement; reject overflow or charge refill.
Use actual ROM/SRAM macro read width and latency for descriptor fetch; 16B/cycle is proposed scheduling service, not physical characterization.
Count row-tile dispatch repetitions ceil(M/tile_rows) and K/group loops according to actual reusable SM launch protocol.1191/1471 are matrix-level dispatches, not necessarily hardware phases.
Measure cold config and continuous loop issue including route ID readiness, draining and backpressure; source-pin program payload and descriptor bounds proof.
